requirements: R1: Update the deliverable readiness calculation to accurately track task completion progress and eliminate false stagnation warnings.

slices.title: Fix readiness metric calculation logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the deliverable readiness fix for this epic, I want to correct the progress calculation algorithm, so that task completions are accurately reflected and false stagnation warnings are prevented.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given ongoing task completions in the project
When the readiness tracking service calculates progress
Then the deliverable readiness correctly advances past 5/19 based on the completed tasks
Given correct progress updates are recorded
When the stagnation warning criteria is evaluated
Then no false stagnation warnings are emitted for actively progressing projects
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease deliverable readiness calculation error rate to 0%
